definitions.explanation: Having the same form, manner, or degree throughout. Describes a situation where there is no variation among multiple elements.

examples.japanese: {一様|いちよう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいる→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
⟦{参加者|さんかしゃ}→参加者：03059_sankasha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一様|いちよう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{驚|おどろ}いた→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧。
examples.english: The participants were all equally surprised.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一様|いちよう}⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧、⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The results were not uniform; there were differences by region.

notes:
{一様|いちよう} describes uniformity or sameness across multiple items or people. It is commonly used as an adverb ({一様|いちよう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧) or as a na-adjective ({一様|いちよう}な).

FORMS:
⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧ (one) + {様|よう} (manner, appearance) = one manner/uniform

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {一様|いちよう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: uniformly, equally
- {一様|いちよう}な: uniform, alike
- {一様|いちよう}で⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: not uniform, varied

USAGE:
This word appears more often in written or formal contexts. In everyday speech, ⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧ (all the same) is more natural.
